definition: The angle you look up through from the horizontal to see an object above you.
The angle you look down through from the horizontal to see an object below you.
A direction given as the angle measured clockwise from north, written with three figures before any decimal point, such as $045^{\circ}$ or $210^{\circ}$.
The bearing of the return journey: if $B$ is on bearing $\theta$ from $A$, then $A$ is on bearing $\theta \pm 180^{\circ}$ from $B$.
